2/ SHIBA INU (SHIB)
Launched in 2020 as the “Dogecoin Killer,” SHIB capitalized on the hype. It introduced staking, an ecosystem, and even NFTs. Still, its strength came from community and meme power—not fundamentals.

1/ Origins: Dogecoin (DOGE)
In 2013, DOGE was launched as a joke based on the popular Doge meme. Despite no real utility, it gained a cult following. Why? Community, fun, and the power of internet culture. Elon Musk's tweets helped fuel the fire.
